derivation: The closed boundary record assigns identity authentication and alias control to the deployment identity provider, fixes failure behavior and evidence, and expressly withholds any claim that distinct strings prove distinct real actors.

input.deployment_verification: Test same-principal aliases, distinct principals, expired identity assertions, and identity-provider unavailability.
input.does_not_establish: Different actor identifier strings represent different real people or systems.
input.establishes: The semantic consumer compares exact actor identifiers and the deployment boundary names the authentication fact needed to rely on that comparison.
input.evidence_format: A deployment identity-assurance record binding each semantic actor identifier to one authenticated principal and recording alias collision checks.
input.external_fact_or_capability: Distinct actor identifiers supplied to the semantic consumer identify distinct authenticated actors in the deployment domain.
input.failure_behavior: Withhold the governed proposal when the host cannot establish distinct authenticated principals for the selected actor identifiers.
input.required_control_or_integration: Authenticate each actor identifier and prevent two credentials for one actor from satisfying a distinct-actor rule through aliases.
input.residual_limitation: The strength of separation assurance depends on the deployment's identity proofing, alias controls, and credential lifecycle.
